    close() - Method in class be.imgn.inject.context.ChildContext
    Closes this child context: rejects further resolution through it, including through the providers it returned, closes its live child contexts, newest first, then destroys the instances of its hosted scope (invoking each factory's @PreDestroy) in reverse creation order.
    close() - Method in interface be.imgn.inject.context.Context
    Destroys this context's scoped instances (invoking their @PreDestroy callbacks) and marks it closed.
    close() - Method in class be.imgn.inject.context.DefaultContext
    Closes the live child contexts, newest first, then destroys every tracked scoped instance (invoking each factory's @PreDestroy) in reverse creation order, and rejects further resolution.
    close() - Method in interface be.imgn.inject.Injector
    Closes this injector: rejects further resolution through it, including through the providers it returned, closes its live child injectors, newest first, then invokes @PreDestroy on every scoped instance it created, in reverse creation order.
